headline: Executive order signed in 2022 about promoting the arts, the humanities, and museum and library services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order directs the federal government to promote the arts, the humanities, and museum and library services. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, programs, or agency duties it sets out cannot be described here.
